cjDropshipping.note: Live catalog API curated to top ~120–150 winners (listedNum/sales/price/EU cues). totalRecords may stay high in meta; products[] is capped for boutique storefront.

printify.note: Sector-filtered catalog mirrors the store query; printify-selected.json is the per-store curated set (~12 items). Left as-is this ship.

gelato.note: Live API via GELATO_API_KEY (store first, then public catalog). Local JSON is empty fallback only — never selected clones.

printful.note: Live API via PRINTFUL_API_TOKEN (store first, then public catalog). Local JSON is empty fallback only — never selected clones.
